facts.fact: The NDPC said it was investigating TikTok and Truecaller on data privacy and issued a directive of guidance for controllers and processors, with no decision reported.
The NDPC is headed by National Commissioner and CEO Vincent Olatunji, who spoke at an Abuja press conference.
The NDPC describes upholding the country's Data Protection Act, treating it as in force; document published 2025-03-24.
